note: Sierra Leone: nationals of the ECOWAS states, Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger enter without a visa; nationals of the countries listed get a month's visa on arrival (free for Barbados, Botswana, Malaysia, Singapore and the others first listed; USD 80, or 25 for African Union nationals, for the rest: the fee isn't modelled); everyone else applies for an e-Visa. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Sierra Leone
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries may enter Sierra Leone without a visa or are eligible for a free visa on arrival: All ECOWAS member states Burkina Faso Mali Niger ... Citizens of the following countries may obtain a free visa on arrival: Barbados Botswana Eswatini Fiji Jamaica Kenya Lesotho Malawi Malaysia Mauritius Saint Kitts and Nevis Singapore Sri Lanka Trinidad and Tobago Citizens of the following countries may obtain a visa on arrival (valid for 1 month) at Freetown International Airport , Jendema (bordering Liberia) and Gbalamuya (bordering Guinea) for a fee 80 USD (unless otherwise noted): African Union member states (except ECOWAS, Burkina Faso, Djibouti, Equatorial Guinea, Ethiopia, Mali and Niger) All European Union member states Antigua and Barbuda Australia Bahrain Bangladesh Belize Bolivia Brazil Brunei Cambodia Canada China Dominica Fiji Grenada Guyana Hong Kong India Indonesia Iran Israel Japan Kiribati Kuwait Lebanon Liechtenstein Macao Nauru New Zealand Norway Oman Pakistan Papua New Guinea Qatar Russia Samoa Saint Lucia Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Saudi Arabia Solomon Islands South Korea Switzerland Thailand Timor-Leste Tonga Turkey Tuvalu United Arab Emirates United Kingdom United States Vanuatu Vietnam ... Citizens of other countries must obtain an e-Visa.
